registration_note: Rules, window, scoring and gates are fixed here before any forward result exists. The git commit that adds this file is the registration; its hash is the registration identifier.

window.sample: 2026 regular-season games from Week 11 onward, each forecast recorded before its own kickoff

scoring.metric: Brier score on the home-win probability: mean of (p_home - y)^2, y = 1 if the home team won, else 0
scoring.unit: game; each game is one forecast per registered forecaster
scoring.exclusions: ties, postponed and cancelled games are excluded and their count is published
scoring.skill: Brier skill score BSS = 1 - BS(forecaster) / BS(PR-01)
scoring.uncertainty: week-cluster bootstrap: resample whole weeks with replacement, 10000 draws, seed 20261115
scoring.multiplicity: registered trials = 2; two-sided alpha 0.05 Bonferroni-corrected to 0.025, so a pass needs the 1.25th percentile of the bootstrap BSS distribution to be above 0
scoring.pass_rule: PASS only if scored games >= minimum_games AND the corrected lower bound of BSS > 0. Otherwise the result is published as NOT PASSED.
scoring.roi: not computed: no official source publishes NFL prices (flag F09 on the Flagged page). ROI cannot be a gate until a price source is registered.

forecasters.name: No-skill benchmark (constant 0.5)
forecasters.role: benchmark against which Brier skill is measured

forecasters.name: Record-share forecast
forecasters.forecast: p_home = PCT_home / (PCT_home + PCT_away), where PCT is the official standings value as printed at the time of the forecast

forecasters.name: Seeded random control
forecasters.role: control: a forecaster with no information; expected Brier near 1/3

not_registrable.name: Net-points strength differential
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (spread_own = f(NPG_home - NPG_away); f is symbolic, coefficient blank)

not_registrable.name: Points-allowed total
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (total_own = f(PA_pg_home + PA_pg_away); coefficients blank)

not_registrable.name: Defensive backup-depth deficiency
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (delta_rank = depth_rank(starter) - depth_rank(actual); effect size blank)

not_registrable.name: Offensive backup-depth deficiency
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (delta_rank = depth_rank(starter) - depth_rank(actual); effect size blank)

not_registrable.name: Practice-status trend
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (trend = ordinal(Full) - ordinal(first report); coefficient blank)

not_registrable.name: Designation-gated availability
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (indicator = 1 if designation published; effect size blank)

not_registrable.name: Two-leg parlay with correlation guard
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (P(parlay) = P(A) x P(B) only if corr(A,B) is measured; corr blank)

not_registrable.name: Same-game player-prop combo
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (joint model requires corr(prop_A, prop_B); corr blank)

not_registrable.name: Prop availability gate
not_registrable.reason: a filter on official status, not a forecast; no official prop prices exist to score it

not_registrable.name: Backup-exposure index
not_registrable.reason: formula has an unfixed coefficient (index = weighted sum; weights blank until validated)

not_registrable.name: Favourites-only control
not_registrable.reason: needs the market favourite; no official source publishes NFL prices (flag F09). A record-based favourite (PR-02) is used instead.

leaderboard_rules.rule: Only forward forecasts recorded before kickoff and scored after the final whistle may appear on the leaderboard. Backtest or in-sample results never appear on the leaderboard.
